card.text: Hot Saturn-mass giant, 1.28 Jupiter radii, that circles its star every 4 days.

introduction.text: WASP-39 b is a puffy gas giant 1.28 times as wide as Jupiter, circling a Sun-like star every four days. Here it is a plain gray sphere of that size.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A gray sphere of the measured radius. No colour or surface is observed; its atmosphere is measured in transmission.
